events.title: Asana founded
events.summary: Dustin Moskovitz and Justin Rosenstein founded Asana in November 2008 — later shipping a task and project tool built after their experience scaling Facebook's internal coordination.
events.about: Asana brought lists, timelines, and workload views to teams outgrowing email — competing with Basecamp and later Monday.com. Its API and integrations made it popular with product and engineering managers who wanted Jira alternatives without enterprise bloat.

narrative.whyChosen: Asana brought Facebook-grade internal task tooling to the broader market.
narrative.whyImportant: It kept PM accessible for teams that found Jira too heavy.
narrative.problemSolved: Growing startups needed structured task tracking beyond shared inboxes.
